Welcome to the official channel of ASU Online!  

Here you’ll find videos on all things ASU Online — how-to’s, most asked questions, profiles of students and faculty, course and degree spotlights and more. Subscribe for updates and start browsing — there’s lots to discover!

ASU Online offers more than 400 nationally ranked and accredited, fully online undergraduate and graduate degree programs, taught by the same award-winning faculty from Arizona State University. 
 
ASU Online offers students:
• The opportunity to earn a world-class degree online from anywhere, anytime. 
• Six start dates per year for most programs, which allows you to begin your degree program sooner. 
• Access to cutting-edge educational technology  
• Individualized guidance; every student is assigned an enrollment coach, a financial aid advisor, an academic advisor and a success coach.

A top-ranked university. Flexible programs. Real support.
That’s a degree better.
